title: PaperEdits Gemini agentic video benchmark flat result summary
description: Field definitions for the deterministic five-pair CSV summary. Empty agentic_vs_static_percent values mean a relative percentage is not reported for bounded quality metrics.

fields.name: section
fields.description: Metric group: quality, efficiency, or constraints.

fields.name: agentic
fields.description: Agentic-mode value across the five valid pairs.

fields.name: static
fields.description: Static-mode value across the five valid pairs.

fields.name: agentic_minus_static
fields.description: Absolute agentic value minus static value in the row unit.

fields.name: agentic_vs_static_percent
fields.description: Relative agentic difference from static for efficiency and count metrics; blank for bounded quality metrics.

fields.name: denominator
fields.description: Number of valid paired fixtures represented by the row.
